proof_step_recovered.excerpt_tex:
对 $E_0\leftrightarrow E_c$ 分量，左乘 $-\mathbb J$ 后得到二次型方程
\[
 a(u,\phi):=\langle\mathbb L_0u,\phi\rangle=\ell(\phi),
 \qquad \phi\in E_c,
\]
并由~\eqref{eq:coercive-Ec-stage2}
\[
 a(u,u)\ge c_0\|u\|_{\mathcal X_1}^2,
 \qquad
 |\ell(\phi)|\le C\|\mathbb B\|\|\phi\|_{\mathcal X_1}.
\]
Lax--Milgram 因而给出
\[
 \|u\|_{\mathcal X_1}\le c_0^{-1}C\|\mathbb B\|,
 \qquad
 \|\mathfrak L_{0c}^{-1}\|+\|\mathfrak L_{c0}^{-1}\|\le C_0.
\]
综上
\begin{equation}\label{eq:Lric-inverse-v52}
 \|\mathfrak L^{-1}Y\|\le C_0\|Y\|.
\end{equation}
proof_step_recovered.warning: The finite-dimensional certificate refutes the general implication from centre form coercivity to a zero-centre Sylvester inverse. It does not disprove the concrete Hartree splitting or the main PDE theorem.
